user.title: NDW Charging Stations
user.description: Enter a bounding box in EPSG:4326: minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat. For example: 5.63,52.03,5.65,52.05. Stations are refreshed every five minutes.

error.invalid_bbox: Enter four decimal coordinates: minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat. Longitude must be between -180 and 180, latitude between -90 and 90, and minimums must be less than maximums.
error.cannot_connect: Could not retrieve charging stations. Check the NDW service and your connection, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This bounding box is already configured.

init.title: Charging station area
init.description: Change the bounding box (minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat). Previously discovered stations outside the new area become unavailable; you can remove their devices manually.

error.invalid_bbox: Enter four ordered decimal coordinates in EPSG:4326: minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat.
